Return drug indication records for approved drugs. Select the drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO term, and maximum phase for the indication. Filter for records where max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Sort by drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO term, and maximum phase for the indication.
